evidence.quoted_text:
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=filename.parent, delete=False) as stream:
        stream.write(data)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        temporary = stream.name
    os.replace(temporary, filename)
evidence.reason: In `atomic`, the staging path is recorded only after `fsync`, and neither the `with` block nor `os.replace` has cleanup for a temporary file created with `delete=False`. If `write`, `flush`, `fsync`, or `os.replace` fails, the named staging file remains on disk, so repeated failed writes can accumulate orphan files. Recording the path before writing and unlinking it in a `finally` block is a routine correctness fix; the successful-post-replace directory sync should remain.
